sections.overview: This marine snailfish of the eastern Pacific is recorded from Isla Guadalupe, Mexico.
sections.identification: Its description characterizes the skin as uniformly pale gray; the scientific name griseus refers to this coloration.
sections.habitat: It is a deep-water fish, but the reported collection was made in midwater and does not establish a precise depth range for the living fish.
sections.diet: The consulted species accounts provide no diet data.
sections.behavior: No species-specific behavior is described in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted accounts do not document its reproduction.
sections.ecology: The type account is based on one specimen, so the species’ ecology remains very poorly known. Its congener P. delawarei is recorded in the Northwest Atlantic near Cape Cod, unlike this eastern-Pacific species.
sections.conservation: The consulted FishBase page does not report an IUCN assessment.
